notes:
The popup says what the clipboard holds, and the manager's editor is the prompt and little else. Builds on [v0.2.18](https://github.com/bekalpaslan/promptline/releases/tag/v0.2.18).

### Popup

- **The clipboard on its own line.** Under the search box, a line shows what the clipboard holds, flags hidden characters in it and counts its lines, says when it is empty (rows that paste it hollow their icon), and says when it still holds the last prompt pasted. Its **Ctrl N** key saves the clipboard as a new prompt. **The "New prompt from clipboard…" bar under the list is gone**; the list gets that row back.
- **Rows read in one glance.** A title with its Ctrl+1..5 key at the right, then the prompt's first line with one tag, a +N for the rest and the {N} badge for what it asks. Three tags and the key used to leave the first line fifteen characters.
- **Errors say what to do.** A failed paste reads "Couldn't paste into that window. The prompt is on your clipboard: press Ctrl+V there to paste it yourself", on two lines, instead of a sentence cut off at the window's width. Esc reads "dismiss" while an error is up.
- **Hidden characters are shown, never obeyed.** A direction override or a terminal escape copied with a web page shows as a named mark such as ⟨RLO⟩ in every preview, and no longer reverses the text after it.
- **Fill-in fields are named in sentence case** ("Standing instructions", "Goal 2"), and a field that is really an unset config parameter says where to set it once.
- **Screen readers hear the list as a list.** Results are a listbox of options under named groups, a row's name is its title, and the action panel's items take focus as you move. Lighthouse accessibility went from 93 to 100.

### Manager

- **The editor is the prompt and little else.** A crumb line says where the prompt sits and holds its use count, its pin and two menus: the crumb's chevron opens **Move to** with the prompt's current place checked, and the ⋯ at the right opens the same menu a row's right-click does. Under it the title alone, the text, the tags, and a **Placeholders** card that shows only what the text holds, each with an × that takes it out of the text, plus one **insert…** chip for the built-ins, the field names your library already uses, or a typed name (`{{name}}` for a config parameter). **The pack select, the group field and Advanced options are gone**; moving a prompt is the Move to menu, and the three parameter cards' Edit toggles went with them.
- **Clicking a pack or group title never hides it.** The click shows its prompts in the pane and opens it in the tree if it was folded; the chevron, ← and **Collapse all** fold. It used to fold the pack as well, like a folder in a file tree, which took the rows out of the sidebar on the most common click in the window.
- **Rows part as you drag one.** The row you are holding takes the slot under the pointer and its neighbours slide out of the way, so what you see mid-drag is what release saves, including a group it lands in. Escape, or the window losing focus, puts the row back where it was with nothing saved; before, a release after Alt+Tab could drop it wherever the pointer last was.
- **One way to delete.** A prompt, a selection, a pack or a group all ask in the same dialog, which names what goes, what is kept and that Undo follows. The armed "Really delete?" button and menu items are gone.
- **Ungroup keeps each prompt in its pack.** On a selection spanning packs it used to gather every prompt into the first one's pack.
- **The overview follows the filter.** While a query is set, a pack's or group's overview shows only the hits and says "2 of 12 match the filter"; the tree and the pane used to disagree. The overview's title is set at the same size as the editor's, one **New prompt** button per overview, and a Ctrl+N anywhere outside a field starts a prompt where the pane is looking.
- **Settings in four cards.** **Packs** lists each pack and its file, with Generate and New pack under it; **Backup and import** holds Export… and Import… as two-item menus and Open folder. The pane's × is gone; the gear above it is the one way out, as is Esc.
- **Honest states.** A library that can't be read says so in the pane instead of "No prompts yet"; an empty library says "No packs yet" under New; an empty pack puts New prompt beside the words; a clipboard that can't be written or a folder that can't be opened says so instead of doing nothing. Long pack and group names stay inside the window in menus and import rows, a long title ends in an ellipsis, and a tag typed as "Review, PLAN" says it landed as #review, #plan.
- **Typing a Japanese, Chinese or Korean name** no longer commits a rename or a tag on the Enter that picks the candidate.

### Appearance

- **UI scale reaches every text size.** Row titles, the search box, group headers and chips grow with Settings → UI scale; they used to stay at 13px while the rest grew. The popup's pack headers drop from 16px to the body size, as in the sidebar.
- **One lit thing at a time.** The search box's border takes the focus colour only while the box has focus, not for as long as a query is set; on a dark selection a tag's text clears the contrast floor.
